subject: Upcoming Transition to the New INLA Website and Support Platform

messages.author: fda1962767a2614c
messages.subject: Upcoming Transition to the New INLA Website and Support Platform
parts:
Dear INLA users,

We are pleased to let you know that we will soon move to our new INLA website. As part of this transition, we are introducing updated channels for submitting questions and reporting issues related to INLA.

The Google Discussion Groups will be discontinued. Going forward, all questions, suggestions, and issue reports should be submitted through our new public issue tracker:

https://github.com/r-inla/r-inla.github.io/issues

This platform will help us streamline communication, keep discussions organized, and provide clearer follow up and tracking for everyone in the community.

We look forward to engaging with you through the new system.

Kind regards,
The INLA Team
